scenario.task:
I already paid my past-due bill yesterday, but my service is still suspended. I want to get it turned back on

User Guide: Say 'My service is suspended but I already paid my bill.' Authenticate. Confirm you paid yesterday. Wait for the system to verify and restore your service If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
